claim: The tweezers must be earthed through the grounding conductor of the specified, certified power cord before anything else is connected or power applied. The back-panel grounding post is only for additional earthing or equalising potential with the table or microscope.
validity_conditions: Read from Tweez 305/310 General Hardware and Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed (sha256 1c112ed1...): printed page 4 (PDF page 6), printed page 9 (PDF page 11). Also Tweez 305/310 General Hardware and Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed (sha256 1c112ed1...): printed page 8 (PDF page 10).
